question: What substances may a devotee use to bathe the goddess in this rite?
premises: The five products of the cow are used.
Milk, kuśa, and waters are used.
The goddess is the object of bathing.
inference: One who bathes the goddess may do so with the five cow products and likewise with milk, kuśa, and waters.
uncertainties: The verse continues into the next verse for the full apodosis.
plain_english: Whoever bathes the goddess with the five products of the cow, and likewise with milk, kuśa, and waters.
